settings.title: Direct communication

settings.question: Why are there no fixed prices?
settings.answer: Requirements vary a great deal between projects. Quoting individually means the price reflects exactly what you need.

settings.question: How do I get a quote?
settings.answer: Choose the package closest to your needs and send the inquiry form. We will reply with questions if needed, then a detailed proposal.

settings.question: Can a package be customised?
settings.answer: Yes. Packages are starting points. Features can be added or removed to match your scope and budget.

settings.question: Which package is right for me?
settings.answer: If you are unsure, tell us about your business and goals. We will recommend the option that fits best.

settings.heading: Tell us what you need. We will quote it.
settings.text: Tell us about your goals and we will come back with a clear plan, timeline and quote.
